setup.name: db-network
args: iface=$(ls /sys/class/net | sed '/^lo$/d' | head -n1); test -n "$iface"; ip link set dev "$iface" up; ip addr flush dev "$iface"; ip addr add 10.77.0.2/24 dev "$iface"

setup.name: web-network
args: iface=$(ls /sys/class/net | sed '/^lo$/d' | head -n1); test -n "$iface"; ip link set dev "$iface" up; ip addr flush dev "$iface"; ip addr add 10.77.0.3/24 dev "$iface"

baseline.name: http-before
args: for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do /usr/bin/python3 /opt/kairon-rehearsal/app.py probe --url http://10.77.0.2:8080/health && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1

verify.name: http-after
args: for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do /usr/bin/python3 /opt/kairon-rehearsal/app.py probe --url http://10.77.0.2:8080/health && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1
